name: Infoblox — PTR Reverse-DNS Sweep
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Query"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "PTR"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter ptr_query = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN PTR"), 0)
| bin _time span = 5m
| comp count() as ptr_queries,
       count_distinct(ptr_query) as distinct_ptrs,
       values(ptr_query) as queried_ptrs
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter ptr_queries >= 100 and distinct_ptrs >= 50
| join type = left (
    dataset = microsoft_windows_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "4624" and _raw_log contains "IpAddress"
    | alter logon_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='IpAddress'>([\d\.]+)<"), 0),
            user_name = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='TargetUserName'>([^<]+)<"), 0)
    | filter logon_ip != null and user_name != null
    | comp values(user_name) as user_name by logon_ip
    | fields logon_ip, user_name
  ) as wbind wbind.logon_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, queried_ptrs, user_name
description: One client issuing many PTR queries — reverse-DNS reconnaissance.
alert_description:
What fired: One client issuing many PTR queries — reverse-DNS reconnaissance.

Why it matters: an actor is enumerating hosts, services, shares, or accounts to map the environment. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1018 - Remote System Discovery (TA0007 - Discovery).

Investigate:
  - Identify the scanning source and the number/range of targets it touched.
  - Confirm the source is not an authorized scanner/vuln tool; look for follow-on access to any enumerated target.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
